snippet.title: Arknights: Endfield [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] Version Trailer
snippet.description:
[Honey Waffle Instruction Manual] 
Indications: Hallucinations such as seeing angry mushrooms roll up their sleeves and come at you, Protocol Dataloggers saying hello to you, or mushroom caps stealthily sprouting on your head. 
Dosage and Administration: Aim for the forehead. One piece at a time. Throw with all your strength. 
Side Effects: You may feel a little dazed for a short while after regaining consciousness. This product accepts no liability for any such effects. 

A single bite, and the sweet dream is over— 
An Investigation into the Mysterious "Mushrooms Chasing People Incident" Begins! As does our adventure — let's go meet those mushrooms!╭(′▽‵)╯
